description: This file contains test utilities for HTTP/2 adapter, including mock classes, data sources, and frame matchers used in testing the quiche HTTP/2 implementation.

classes.name: DataSavingVisitor
classes.description: A mock visitor class that saves data and metadata for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestDataFrameSource
classes.description: A test data source that simulates sending data frames.

classes.name: TestMetadataSource
classes.description: A test metadata source that encodes header entries into frames.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Handles data ready to send, respecting send limits and error states.

methods.name: OnMetadataForStream
methods.description: Handles incoming metadata for a stream, storing it internally.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stored metadata for a specific stream.

methods.name: set_send_limit
methods.description: Sets the maximum amount of data to send.

methods.name: is_write_blocked
methods.description: Checks if writing is currently blocked.

methods.name: AppendPayload
methods.description: Appends payload data to the source.

methods.name: EndData
methods.description: Marks the end of data stream.

methods.name: SimulateError
methods.description: Simulates an error in data transmission.

methods.name: SelectPayloadLength
methods.description: Selects payload length for sending, possibly returning an error.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a frame with header and payload.

methods.name: send_fin
methods.description: Indicates if the stream should send a FIN flag.

methods.name: NumFrames
methods.description: Calculates number of frames needed based on max frame size.
